skill.name: Completeness Validation
skill.purpose: Stage-level completeness gate. Never report complete/success when any gap remains.

no_false_complete.rule: status=complete only after filesystem verification of every gate. Any gap or skipped inspection => status=incomplete. Never success.
must_fail_when: any skill required_field missing or empty
any JSON in this stage lacks a same-path Markdown twin
Technical Story stage and a Feature folder has no Technical-Stories/ST-*.json
Epic-Feature stage and a Feature lacks FAC or AAC JSON
